bento.title: About Me
bento.subtitle: An engineering profile combining systems vision, technical rigor, and product execution.
bento.academicText: Software Engineering Design Degree (DIC) in Computer Science at ESP Dakar, following a CS Technology Degree (DUT) and a Scientific Baccalaureate with Honors (Mention Bien).
bento.card1Text: I design and build web applications, APIs, and enterprise systems combining full-stack development, data management, service integration, and automation. My journey spans diverse challenges from business SaaS platforms to third-party APIs and payment integrations. I am deeply invested in engineering reliable, scalable, and secure systems, with an active focus on Cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps.
bento.card2Text: Hands-on experience designing business solutions and integrating third-party services, particularly around digital payments, messaging APIs, and financial process automation.
bento.card3Text: Exploring generative AI, Cloud infrastructure, and IoT across various engineering projects, with a strong focus on automation, intelligent data parsing, and connected systems.
bento.card4Text: Deep sensitivity to security requirements, system reliability, high availability, and scalability in application engineering.

exp.title: Work Experience

Integrated WhatsApp Business API for automated dispatch of invoices, payment links, reminders, and receipts.

Designed automated ledger engines generating accounting entries from invoices and settlements under SYSCOHADA standards with authorization gates.

Engineered automated PDF/HTML rendering engines for invoices, receipts, and financial exports.
Integrated generative AI capabilities using Google Gemini / Vertex AI for intelligent data extraction from uploaded receipts and financial documents.

spadon.context: Architectural overhaul and performance optimization for Spadon's web platform.
points: Engineered a full architectural and visual overhaul of Spadon's web platform for high responsiveness.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A curated selection of technical achievements spanning web platforms, 5G networks, AI, and IoT.

fiveg.title: 5G Network Designer (5G Planning & Dimensioning Tool)
fiveg.subtitle: Interactive 5G network dimensioning and dynamic mapping platform (COST-231 Hata model, Shannon capacity, Google Maps API)
fiveg.desc: End-to-end 5G network dimensioning tool (coverage modeling, Shannon capacity, gNodeB optimal count, backhaul sizing, and geocoded dynamic mapping).
fiveg.fullDesc: Design and implementation of a 5G network dimensioning and deployment platform, developed within the Networks, Telecoms & Services (RTS) curriculum at ESP Dakar. The platform determines technical parameters for geographic zones, calculates radio coverage (COST-231 Hata & 3GPP models), throughput capacity (Shannon formula & spectral efficiency), optimal gNodeB count, and backhaul requirements (fiber, microwave, satellite), with interactive Google Maps geocoded site mapping.
features: Interactive definition of 5G network parameters (geographic zone, population density, frequency bands).
Automated radio coverage modeling (COST-231 Hata) and theoretical capacity calculation (Shannon formula).
Optimal gNodeB base station deployment sizing and backhaul link dimensioning (Fiber, Microwave, Satellite).
Dynamic interactive site visualization with geocoding via Google Maps API.
Custom parameters across dense urban, suburban, and rural propagation environments.

waxtaan.title: Waxtaan (WhatsApp Cloud Clone)
waxtaan.subtitle: High-performance real-time instant messaging cloud platform
waxtaan.desc: Scalable WhatsApp clone combining Next.js and Spring Boot with secure WebSocket communication and multi-chat state management.
waxtaan.fullDesc: Waxtaan is an instant messaging application engineered for sub-50ms latency and high concurrent traffic. Built with a resilient Spring Boot backend and a TypeScript/Next.js frontend, it leverages STOMP over WebSockets for bi-directional communication.
features: Sub-second real-time messaging via WebSockets and STOMP.
Stateless JWT authentication and secure session encryption.
Live presence indicators (online/offline) and message delivery receipts.
Clean, responsive interface styled with modern Tailwind CSS.

dataeval.title: Data-Eval (AI-Powered Database Evaluator)
dataeval.subtitle: AI-powered database evaluation and SQL correction framework
dataeval.desc: Innovative platform parsing and automatically evaluating complex SQL queries and relational schemas using DeepSeek AI.
dataeval.fullDesc: Data-Eval bridges the gap in database education and code review. It parses relational schemas and SQL queries, evaluates execution plans, and interfaces with DeepSeek AI to provide instant corrections, educational insights, and performance recommendations.
features: Deep syntactic & semantic analysis of PostgreSQL and MySQL queries.
Optimized prompt-engineering pipeline tailored to database constraints.
User query history tracking and performance benchmarking dashboard.

ecg.title: CardioCare IoT & Telemedicine
ecg.subtitle: Real-time telemedicine IoT cardiac telemetry system
ecg.desc: Connected medical device utilizing an AD8232 sensor, ESP32 microcontroller, and MQTT protocol for continuous remote ECG monitoring.
ecg.fullDesc: A medical-grade telemetry system enabling healthcare professionals to monitor patients' electrocardiographic (ECG) signals in real time. Bio-signals captured by the ESP32 are streamed over MQTT to an Express.js backend and rendered live on an interactive React dashboard.
features: Low-latency streaming of ECG waveforms via MQTT / WebSockets.
Automated arrhythmia anomaly detection algorithms with alert triggers.
Interactive doctor dashboard with historical playback and report exports.

maternity.title: MaternitéPlus (Hospital Management)
maternity.subtitle: Hospital management and obstetric patient tracking system
maternity.desc: Secure web application optimizing patient records, prenatal visits, and newborn tracking for healthcare teams.
maternity.fullDesc: Engineered to streamline maternity ward operations, this system centralizes patient electronic health records (EHR), schedules antenatal visits, and maintains birth registers under strict role-based access control.
features: Role-based access control for doctors, midwives, and administrators.
Real-time monitoring of patient admissions and maternity ward occupancy.
Automated statistical health reports and encrypted data archiving.

spadon.title: Spadon Multi-Channel Automation
spadon.subtitle: Automated multi-channel client notification engine
spadon.desc: Scheduled campaign delivery engine (SMTP Email & WhatsApp) with enterprise Tomcat security enforcement.
spadon.fullDesc: Enterprise messaging software ensuring reliable, automated dispatch of transactional and promotional communications for Spadon's clients with zero manual overhead.
features: CronJob scheduling with resilient message queue handling.
Integration with Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Google SMTP relay.
Hardened Tomcat server security with encrypted credentials.

bnf.title: BNF Expression Parser in C
bnf.subtitle: BNF grammar interpreter and arithmetic expression parser in C
bnf.desc: Low-level parser implementation strictly following BNF grammar with operator precedence trees and syntax validation.
bnf.fullDesc: A systems programming project demonstrating deep mastery of language theory, compiler design fundamentals, and low-level memory management in C. Tokenizes, builds Abstract Syntax Trees (AST), and evaluates arithmetic expressions.
features: Lexer and recursive-descent parser adhering to formal BNF rules.
Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) construction with strict operator precedence.
Robust error reporting and memory leak prevention.
